traits.name: Mandibles
traits.text: ⬻ Requirements A creature is grabbed and paralyzed by the chuul's tentacles. Effect The creature takes 3d6 (3d6) piercing damage.

traits.name: Paralytic Venom
traits.text: (incapacitation, poison); Saving Throw DC 25 Fortitude. Maximum Duration 6 rounds Stage 1 paralyzed. (1 round)

traits.name: Tentacle Transfer
traits.text: ⬻ Requirements The chuul has a creature grabbed. Effect The chuul transfers the grabbed creature from its claws to its tentacles, or vice versa. A creature is exposed to the chuul's paralytic venom when transferred into the tentacles and at the start of each of the chuul's turns if it remains grabbed by the tentacles.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ claws +19 (reach 10 feet); Damage 2d8+9 (2d8+9) bludgeoning plus Grab
